scripts.prepack: node -e "const {cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync} = require('node:fs'); const {dirname, join} = require('node:path'); const cwd = process.cwd(); const source = join(cwd, '../openapi-rescript-core/src'); const target = join(cwd, 'vendor/openapi-rescript-core/src'); rmSync(join(cwd, 'vendor'), {recursive: true, force: true}); mkdirSync(dirname(target), {recursive: true}); cpSync(source, target, {recursive: true});"
scripts.postpack: node -e "const {rmSync} = require('node:fs'); const {join} = require('node:path'); rmSync(join(process.cwd(), 'vendor'), {recursive: true, force: true});"
